title: Spicy Penne Pasta
description: A quick and spicy penne pasta dish perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the flavors of Italy with a kick of heat.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy Canadian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the kicked sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Simmer the sauce for a few minutes until heated through.
Drain the cooked penne pasta and add it to the skillet with the sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
